summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine insider share purchases by directors and PDMRs under UK Market Abuse Regulation Article 19. CEO Mike Duffy bought 10,500 ADSs at $23.7946; Therese Esperdy's trust bought 21,214 ADSs at $23.3728; and Leanne Sheraton bought 10,000 ordinary shares at $4.8072. These are personal, open-market transactions, not a corporate action. No deal terms, board recommendation, or strategic event; purely a disclosure of management ownership changes. There is no special-situation angle; the filing is routine and not classified as a special situation.
